summary: Add host-authoritative finite resource lane custody with durable clocks and reactive admission

replay.detail: A replayed acquire validates the live host authority and exact generation. Restart fences old grants and reconciles their execution roots before releasing custody; it never relaunches a payload.

schema.detail: Host-local resource authorities, immutable named policies and execution memberships retain owner run/step/attempt references, execution roots and queue, payload and retirement clocks.

rules.detail: Host holds, logical occupancy and finite physical fit are checked in the same local writer transaction. The admission budget includes preparation through the first payload release, checked under the authorization writer guard. Expired gated producers retain capacity until retirement is proven. Seat admission reads the same finite inventory. Committed local observations wake lane and shared-fit readers without polling.

compatibility.detail: Named policy maxMembers, capacity and coverage cannot be changed by a competing requester. Execution host identity, owner and authority epoch are checked independently of replicated observations.

downtime.detail: Existing workloads do not acquire finite memberships unless explicitly declared.

manual.detail: External admission and target-host hold bridges remain until each workload and mutation adapter is explicitly cut over; do not nest two physical reservations.

recovery.detail: Unknown preparation and unconfirmed teardown retain occupancy and diagnostics. Only positive producer rejection can erase an unlaunched intent. Host-local monotonic elapsed clocks preserve budgets and explicitly report restart uncertainty. After leader PID reuse, a validated exact-scope closure proof reconciles and persists group retirement without signalling the reused PID.
